Progression to query/success is supported by the unchanged hash-bound installer control flow requiring their exact all-true sets; no fresh raw health report is invented.

Its created state and configured_only evidence are correctly labelled installed_before_startup. Later successful transport/checks are separate evidence, not a relabelled snapshot.
controlflow_interpretation.success_disposition: The recorded successful path leaves the four prepared replacements running as approved; no recovery event or recovery attempt is recorded. This review performs no current-state postcheck.
controlflow_interpretation.rollback: rollback_verified=false and exact-baseline null are not evaluated recovery outcomes. No healthy or exact restoration claim is made.
controlflow_interpretation.consumed_attempt: The receipt/outcome show attempt reserved and preparation consumed. Do not rerun or reset this attempt. This review grants no further action.

limits: Acceptance is this single committed archival runtime proof only. It does not establish blanket production readiness, unrestricted interactive research or continued health after the recorded window.
All nine compatibility and five evidence results are saved controller/verifier attestations. No new native check or independent DB/source-body verification was performed by the reviewer.
Five hash correlations identify archived documents and URLs; raw answer prose is ephemeral, so full response/predicate replay is unavailable and was not attempted.
The approved archival market exclusion is intentional, not an absence-of-ticks claim or general market readiness. No external model or actual browser/UI path was tested.
Primary invalid_envelope is explained by probe isolation, not a diagnosis of production primary API availability.
The created-state installation payload is a pre-start configuration lane, even though its event appears later; it is not a fresh post-start inventory or independently certified network map.
Successful source-backed query and required recipient/health checks are bounded observations through records, not sustained health, exhaustive SDK behavior or full image/dependency closure.
No recovery was needed or tested on this attempt. False/null rollback fields imply neither failed recovery nor healthy/exact restoration.
Logs/audit effects can persist. No token value appears in the reviewed saved diagnostic output, but no universal log-absence or secure zeroization claim is made.
No profitability, economic edge, trading eligibility, new risk/schedule/account settings or deployment-wide acceptance follows.
Historical packet/handoff checkpoint hashes remain precloseout references. Exact source/review/record bindings were checked; no executable drift waiver was used.
No follow-on action, retry/reset, live postcheck, service mutation, query or credential access is authorized by this review.
